title: Teh Tarik Bergambar
mood: warm, shy and quietly in love
subject: a teh tarik puller at an Ipoh kopitiam who makes the same drink for one woman every morning and finally draws something in the foam
caption: Sabahan sumazau pop, Kadazan-Dusun dance rhythm in a gentle modern Malay pop song. Breathy sompoton bamboo mouth-organ riff, interlocking tagung gongs keeping a soft sumazau pulse, bright kulintangan runs, strummed acoustic guitar and a round bass guitar. Open airy mix with gongs panned wide over a light pop rhythm section. Male tenor lead with a soft female answer in the last chorus, clear relaxed tone. 112 BPM, D major. Warm, shy and quietly in love. No autotune, no trap beat, no EDM drop, no rock distortion, no dangdut tabla.
lyrics:
[Intro - sompoton riff over tagung gongs]

[Verse 1]
Pukul tujuh, kedai baru buka
Kau duduk meja tepi tiang
Teh tarik kurang manis, selalu
Aku tarik tinggi, tak tumpah

[Pre-Chorus]
Dah setahun aku hafal
Tapi nama kau aku tak tahu

[Chorus]
Teh tarik bergambar
Aku lukis atas buih
Satu hati kecil, senget sikit
Aku hantar, terus lari

[Verse 2]
Kau angkat gelas, kau berhenti
Kau tengok aku belakang kaunter
Tauke ketawa, cawan jatuh
Muka aku merah macam sos

[Pre-Chorus]
Kau datang ke kaunter
Kau tulis nama atas resit

[Chorus - Duet]
Teh tarik bergambar
Esok lukis lagi, kau kata
Nama kau Aini, aku simpan resit
Esok aku lukis dua

[Outro - kulintangan and gongs, duet hum]
